输入英文单词，查看释义、例句并播放发音。首次使用会准备核心词典，下载后可离线查词: Enter an English word to see definitions, examples, and pronunciation. The core dictionary is prepared on first use. Once downloaded, it works offline.

设置中可切换语言和调整每日目标。填写 DeepSeek API Key 后，还可: In Settings, change the language and daily goals. Add a DeepSeek API key to use AI definitions and context articles.
